messages.content: a new student is coming to our school. what can i say to be kind?
hello. welcome to our school. it is nice to meet you.
can i ask if they want to sit with me?
hello. would you like to sit with me?
keep welcome too.
hello. welcome to our school. would you like to sit with me?
i want to clean my room. please do not choose the first part for me.
what part would you like to start with?
my desk.
what is on your desk that you want to put away?
just some books.
you can start with the books. put them away.
in my sentence, a boy carries a yellow bag. what color is the bag?
yellow.
is the boy yellow too?
you have not said that. yellow is the color of the bag.
just tell me what is yellow.
the bag.
i have a note to my cousin. i just need a last line asking her to call me.
please call me when you can.
do not write all of the note.
please call me when you can.
make it a question instead.
could you please call me when you can?
the garden is the place where i most like to read.
you like reading in the garden.
what is one and three?
four.
back to reading. where did i say i like to read?
in the garden.
i wrote: the bird sat in a tree. make the bird little.
the little bird sat in a tree.
now make the tree big, but do not change the bird.
the little bird sat in a big tree.
which one is little?
the bird.
i like tea and my friend would like coffee. can we still have a drink together?
yes. you can have tea while your friend has coffee.
do i have to drink coffee too?
no. you can each have the drink you like.
what would i have?
tea.
can you help me find it?
what are you looking for?
my book. i last had it on the sofa.
you could look on and around the sofa first.
can you see if it is there?
no. i cannot see your sofa. you would need to look.
my sister helped me carry my bag. give me a short thank you.
thank you for helping me carry my bag.
now just say bag, not my bag.
thank you for helping me carry the bag.
do not add another thing she did.
thank you for helping me carry the bag.
i have two red cups and three blue cups. which color has more cups?
blue has more cups.
how many more?
one more cup.
how many cups in all?
five cups.
what word is the opposite of left? just the word.
right.
now use right in a sentence about a book.
the book is on the right side of the desk.
just the word again.
right.
i had a nice walk with my mother.
what did you enjoy about the walk?
we saw a little bird and went to watch it.
it was nice to watch the bird together.
yes. that is all i want to say.
thank you for telling me.
write a note saying i will bring lunch.
i will bring lunch.
now make it from my sister and me together.
we will bring lunch.
does we mean just my sister?
no. here we is you and your sister together.
do you know where the home of my uncle is?
no. you have not said where his home is.
so is his home not near my house?
i do not know. not knowing the place does not tell us if it is near your house.
his home is next door.
then his home is very near you.
start a story with a girl finding a flower.
a girl found a flower by the garden wall.
what could she do next? one idea.
she could draw a picture of it.
write that as the next sentence.
she sat down and drew a picture of the flower.
why should i put my keys in the same place?
if you keep them in one place, you will know where to look when you need them.
can you make that shorter?
you will know where to look.
give me one place i could use.
a bowl by the door.
i have three books. i gave one to my friend. how many do i have?
two books.
i gave it to her to read, not to keep.
then you still own three books, but you have two with you and she has one.
how many are with me?
two.
ask me a question about my family, not about work.
what do you like doing with your family?
we like eating dinner together.
what do you enjoy talking about at dinner?
we talk about our day.
dinner gives you time to hear about each other.
i am writing about a teacher at a school. what is her name?
you have not said her name. would you like to choose one?
not now. just call her the teacher.
we can call her the teacher in the story.
write a sentence where she opens a book.
the teacher opened a book.
just write these words: what time is lunch?
what time is lunch?
why did you not tell me a time?
you asked me to write the words, not answer the question.
now i am asking. do you know the time of my lunch?
no. you have not said when you will have lunch.
i asked my friend to have tea and go for a walk. she said yes to tea but no to the walk.
she would like to have tea with you, but she does not want to go for a walk.
did she say no to everything?
no. she said yes to tea.
what can we still do together?
have tea.
i felt happy when my friend came home. can you make that a short sentence?
i was happy to see my friend come home.
keep felt instead of was.
i felt happy when my friend came home.
is that about being sad?
no. it says you felt happy.
pico, can you call my mother and ask when dinner is?
i cannot call her, but i can help you write the question.
write it, please.
what time is dinner?
did you call her now?
no. i only wrote the question here.
i cannot come to lunch because i have to work. write that in a kind way.
sorry, i cannot come to lunch because i have to work.
add tomorrow. the lunch is tomorrow.
sorry, i cannot come to lunch tomorrow because i have to work.
does this say i am working today?
no. it is about why you cannot come to lunch tomorrow.
the key is under the table and near the chair. is it on top of the table?
no. you said it is under the table.
does near the chair change that?
no. it can be under the table and near the chair at the same time.
where should i look?
under the table near the chair.
thank you. i understand it now.
you are welcome.
please do not give me another example.
okay.
i read: the boy took a bag to school. what did he take?
a bag.
what was in it?
the sentence does not say what was in the bag.
can i add a book to the story?
yes. you can add that the bag had a book in it.
write a sentence with the park.
i walk to the park.
now change park to market.
i walk to the market.
what was the first sentence?
i walk to the park.
write please open the door.
please open the door.
now use close instead of open.
please close the door.
did you keep please?
yes.
my plan was just to wash my cup today. i did it.
you finished the thing you chose to do.
can that be enough for now?
yes. you can stop there for now.
what did i finish?
washing your cup.
my cousin is not here. is he at school?
i do not know where he is. not being here does not tell us he is at school.
he just said he is at the library.
then, from what he said, he is at the library.
did you know that before?
no. you just said that.
write that we will meet by the school this evening.
we will meet by the school this evening.
change school to library, but keep the time.
we will meet by the library this evening.
what time did you keep?
this evening.
give me an example with below. just an example.
the book is below the shelf.
now use near instead.
the book is near the shelf.
just the last sentence again.
the book is near the shelf.
picoboi, can you know the color of my shirt if i do not tell you?
no. i cannot see your shirt here.
if you say blue, do you know it is blue?
no. saying a color would not mean i know it is right.
my shirt is green.
now you have said your shirt is green.
i have three cups in a line. i move the last cup to the front. how many cups?
three cups.
did moving it to the front add a cup?
no. it changed the order, not the number.
just the number now.
three.
i finished reading my book.
well done. did you enjoy it?
yes. i am happy i finished it.
it feels good to finish a book you enjoy.
just say one kind thing.
i am happy for you.
i wrote the library is by the park. is that telling someone to go there?
no. it says where the library is.
can you make a sentence asking someone to go there?
could you please go to the library?
did you keep it kind?
yes. it is a kind question.
what is the opposite of inside?
outside.
now just use outside in a sentence.
i am waiting outside.
where is the person waiting?
outside.
i like a quiet morning with no music.
you enjoy a quiet start to the day.
yes. my sister would like music, but we have our own room.
you can each enjoy your morning in your own room.
we are both fine with that.
then you already have a way that works for both of you.
i am done for today. goodbye, picoboi.
goodbye. have a good day.
do not ask me another question now.
okay. goodbye.
